turns.query: What is SAP BRIM and which main components does it consist of?
key_points: SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) supports usage- and subscription-based billing (quote/order to cash)
Names Subscription Order Management (SOM)
Names SAP Convergent Charging (CC)
Names SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI)
Names Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA)

turns.query: What is the difference between a consumption item and a billable item in SAP Convergent Invoicing?
key_points: Consumption items hold usage/consumption data that still has to be rated or priced
Billable items are priced items that are ready to be billed
Billable items are billed into billing documents in Convergent Invoicing

turns.query: What is a provider contract in SAP BRIM?
key_points: A provider contract is the (long-term) contract with the customer in FI-CA / SAP BRIM
It contains contract items for the services or products sold
It is linked to a business partner and a contract account

turns.query: What is the role of SAP Convergent Charging in SAP BRIM?
key_points: Convergent Charging rates and charges usage events/consumption
Pricing logic is modelled in charge plans / price plans
Charging results are passed on to Convergent Invoicing for billing

turns.query: How does the end-to-end order-to-cash process flow across SOM, Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing and FI-CA?
key_points: The order/subscription is captured in SOM and results in a provider contract
Usage is rated in Convergent Charging
Rated items are passed to Convergent Invoicing as billable items and billed
Invoicing creates invoices that are posted to FI-CA
FI-CA handles receivables, payments and dunning

turns.query: What happens during billing and invoicing in SAP Convergent Invoicing?
key_points: Billing selects billable items and creates billing documents
Invoicing takes billing documents and creates invoicing documents
Invoicing posts the amounts to FI-CA

turns.query: How does the dunning process work in FI-CA?
key_points: A dunning proposal run determines overdue items and dunning levels
A dunning activity run executes the dunning activities (for example letters or charges)
The dunning procedure with its dunning levels controls the process

turns.query: How are incoming payments processed in FI-CA?
key_points: Incoming payments can be processed with a payment lot or the payment run
Payments are allocated to and clear open items
Payments that cannot be allocated go to clarification

turns.query: Which FI-CA database table stores the open items of contract account documents?
key_points: Table DFKKOP stores the items of contract account documents (open items)
DFKKKO is the document header table

turns.query: Which transactions are used to create, change and display a contract account in FI-CA?
key_points: CAA1 creates a contract account
CAA2 changes a contract account
CAA3 displays a contract account

turns.query: Which transaction shows the account balance of a business partner in FI-CA?
key_points: Transaction FPL9 displays the account balance

turns.query: How are the database tables for billable items organised in SAP Convergent Invoicing?
key_points: Billable item tables are generated per billable item class
There are separate tables for different statuses of billable items (for example raw, billable, billed)

turns.query: How do you configure a billable item class in SAP Convergent Invoicing?
key_points: The billable item class is defined in Customizing for Convergent Invoicing
Interface components are selected for the class
The class must be generated so its tables and interfaces are created

turns.query: How do you set up a dunning procedure in FI-CA?
key_points: Define the dunning procedure in FI-CA Customizing
Define dunning levels with their activities (and charges or interest if needed)
The dunning procedure is assigned to the contract account

turns.query: What has to be configured for the billing process in SAP Convergent Invoicing?
key_points: A billing process is defined
Billing types are defined and assigned
Billable item classes or source types are assigned so billable items can be selected

turns.query: Billable items stay in status billable and are never billed. What should I check?
key_points: Check whether a billing run was executed for these items and its selection (billing process, contract accounts)
Check the billing run logs / application log for errors
Check blocks or missing master data such as the contract account or provider contract assignment

turns.query: The invoicing run did not pick up our billing documents. What are possible causes?
key_points: The billing documents may not be released for invoicing or may contain errors
The invoicing run selection (invoicing process, accounts, dates) may not match
Invoicing locks or blocks may prevent processing

turns.query: A customer payment arrived but the open item is still not cleared in FI-CA. How do I investigate?
key_points: Check whether the payment was posted or is in clarification
Check the payment allocation (reference, amount, account) to the open item
Check blocks on the open item or the contract account

turns.query: How do SAP Convergent Charging and SAP Convergent Invoicing exchange data?
key_points: Convergent Charging sends charged/rated items to Convergent Invoicing, where they become billable items
Master data such as the provider contract is distributed to Convergent Charging

turns.query: How does Subscription Order Management integrate with FI-CA and Convergent Charging?
key_points: SOM creates or changes the provider contract
The contract data is distributed to FI-CA
The charging-relevant contract data is distributed to Convergent Charging

turns.query: What is the role of SAP Convergent Mediation in SAP BRIM?
key_points: Convergent Mediation collects usage data from source systems
It validates, converts or aggregates the records
It forwards the usage data to charging or invoicing
